srList.sentence: The exclusion criteria were severe liver disease (liver cirrhosis or serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST) or alanine aminotransferase (ALT) activities >120 U/L), severe kidney disease (estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR] <60 mL/minute/1.73 m2), malignant disease, haematological disease and serum bilirubin concentration greater than two times the upper limit of the normal range.

srList.sentence: Sarcopenia was defined as a SMI <7.0 kg/m2 in men and <5.4 kg/m2 in women, according to the Asian Working Group for Sarcopenia recommendations.
